q: In pyramidal training, what is the skill that the middle tier acquires?
choices: A. Data collection and graphing conventions

q: Tomlinson et al. (2018) concluded that trainee fidelity following telehealth training was:
choices: A. Variable across the studies they reviewed
B. Not measured in any of the reviewed studies
C. Uniformly poor except for assessment skills
D. Consistently equivalent to in-person training
